items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Like Little David tried with Goliath. Well, what other fool would go out there with a slingshot to kill a man as big as Goliath.

ctx.x: (sings) And we -- it was an arrangement see, that they had never heard before. So whether it was good or bad, it was something they had never heard before. The man said, "You don't have to finish it. You're good." Have you got another number?" Said, "Yeah, got a whole book of numbers like that." Which we did. So he said, "Well, I'll tell you, you guys go home and clean up and shine your shoes and shine your horns up and be down here at half past seven and we'll put you on." We come back at half past seven, in…

to work til nine thirty or ten o'clock, see. So, we made it and we was a success, see? We substituted for the Marine Band, and if somebody had of told me that I was going to do that, I would have said, 'Are you crazy?' But it shows you, when you're young and you're dedicated, you try things that you wouldn't dare. Like Little David tried with Goliath. Well, what other fool would go out there with a slingshot to kill a man as big as Goliath. That's what we did. That's exactly what we did.
